body.message:
Please note that, as a holiday home operator, our working hours are from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM. We will be able to assist you with your check-in until 9:00 PM.

If you are expected to arrive after 9:00 PM, we will need to arrange for one of our agents to assist you with the late check-in. Please note that this service is subject to an additional charge of AED 500.

I will share the payment link with you shortly. Kindly complete the payment to confirm your late check-in arrangement.
